title: Bounded random-frozen-writer attribution and decision-cost control
parent: DEV-040A original and DEV-040A-posthoc diagnostics; their outcomes remain unchanged
question: Does training bounded banked MTSK recurrent writer weights improve prediction and physical decisions compared with keeping identical initial writer weights frozen while allowing matched encoder/query/reader/head learning?

primary.name: calibrated_cost_per_entity_trainable_minus_frozen
primary.success: paired mean cost < 0 AND mean failures <= frozen AND completed paired runs
primary.condition: descriptive development criterion; no p-value or architecture promotion with three seeds

arms.name: bounded_trainable
arms.intervention: Train encoder, 768-scalar bounded entity-local writer, query encoder, adapter and head

arms.name: bounded_random_frozen
arms.intervention: Identical initial tensors and training exposure as bounded_trainable, but freeze all memory module parameters before optimizer construction

arms.name: memoryless
arms.intervention: Common public features, event/query encoding and head, no recurrent historical state; train remaining weights

train.loss: uniform cross entropy across all 8 entities and 3 queries, pre/post-inspection mean

calibration.selection: min physical cost on calibration labels; ties nearest 0.25 then lower threshold

evaluation.deadline_conditioning: mature excludes before; pending before separately
evaluation.paired_counterfactuals: preserve paired worlds as inseparable grouping
evaluation.explicit_action_query: wait and service future labels scored separately
evaluation.last_event: fit (kind,value,due status) lookup on disjoint public calibration/training worlds, no oracle knowledge at eval

integrity.training_provenance: archive initial/final tensors, RNG optimizer and fingerprints
integrity.independent_audit: regenerate cases and cost from public labels; strict model prediction and physical replay
integrity.evidence: publish raw checkpoints + analyses as GitHub Actions download; retain failure artifacts

limitations: one generator with known entity routing
three initializations insufficient for reliability inference
physical decision comparisons conditional on same synthetic generator
last-event baseline may solve task; do not claim learned necessity
not the original six-expert MTSK or complete PLM-CDL-CASM-OSM
future configuration-disjoint test and 10+ fresh seeds required
